S12 rf-61f and S13 rf-74f both ~0.221 — random_forest dominates this session

proposed_experiments.name: auto_calibration_selection
proposed_experiments.description: Evaluate all 3 calibration methods (sigmoid, isotonic, none) at fitness eval time. Keep best. Currently the GA hardcodes calibration per config. 1 extra forward pass per eval.

proposed_experiments.name: compact_feature_lock
proposed_experiments.description: Lock top-3 compact configs (S10 53f, S12 61f, S13 74f) as permanent elites. Seed every new island cycle with these as starting individuals. Prevents population drift to 200f.

proposed_experiments.name: stacked_meta_learner
proposed_experiments.description: Train logistic regression meta-learner on predictions from top-5 current islands (S10/S12/S13/S15/S17). Nature Scientific Reports approach. GPU burst experiment.

proposed_experiments.name: political_extra_trees_nudge
proposed_experiments.description: NBA converges to random_forest/extra_trees 53-74f. Nudge Political P6 (extra_trees specialist) with NBA S10 compact config as seed. Cross-pollination signal.

immediate_win: E1 (auto_calibration_selection) — change 5 lines in engine.py fitness eval, deploy to one island, measure Brier delta over 50 gens
